test_join_how_sort: test DataFrame.join with different how and sort parameters for inner, left, right, and outer joins
test_join_validate_constraint: test DataFrame.join validate parameter with one_to_one, one_to_many, many_to_one, and many_to_many constraints
test_join_multiindex_dates: test DataFrame.join with MultiIndex containing datetime values across multiple DataFrames
test_join_tzaware_index: test DataFrame.join with timezone-aware DatetimeIndex preserving timezone on outer join
test_join_categorical_index: test DataFrame.join with CategoricalIndex preserving dtype and column names
